sharedRules.description:
- All **[Torrent]** and **[Melta]** weapons suffer -1 to wound when targeting a unit with this rule
- At the end of each turn roll a D6 if a model with this rule is wounded. On a 6+ restore a wound on the model. If it already has a similar rule (End of turn roll a dice and on x+ heal 1 wound) instead add 1 to the roll.
